chosen.title: The Failure Boundary Axiom
chosen.idea: An austere, structural typographic manifesto set on a matte industrial steel plate. High-contrast sans-serif type delivers the core quote: 'Isolation does not remove market risk, but it restricts the boundary of failure.' Below, a small monospaced ledger footer anchors the reality of current Stellar Soroban capital: 'Blend Pool TVL: $157,161,882 | Base Fee: 100 | Risk Radius: Bounded'. No floating tokens or decorative crypto gradients; purely editorial, authoritative, and sobering.
chosen.why: Since hero_stat, sequence, diagram, and comparison have all been recently deployed, moving to a pure typographic quote breaks visual fatigue while delivering maximum intellectual punch. It treats isolation as an engineering discipline rather than a flashy feature, directly speaking to sophisticated risk managers.

all.title: Mutualized Cistern vs. Watertight Bulkheads
all.idea: A dual-state technical cross-section comparing pool architectures. The left pane depicts a shared reservoir holding $157.1M where an insolvency fissure at the bottom drags down the entire water level across all unnamed participant markers. The right pane shows discrete, sealed vertical bulkheads; one compartment experiences a complete internal drop, but the neighboring cells remain undisturbed at full reserve capacity, accompanied by minimal technical blueprint annotations.
all.why: Visually grounds the maritime engineering analogy of watertight compartments, making the mathematical reality of segregated bad debt immediately intelligible without relying on generic DeFi charts or neon crypto tropes.

all.title: Perimeter Containment Blueprint
all.idea: An engineering schematic mapping default propagation. A single redlined collateral failure node attempts to bleed outward, but hits an impermeable double-line partition wall labeled 'Isolated Account Boundary'. Beyond the partition, the primary liquidity pool representing $157.16M Blend TVL is shaded in calm slate-grey, untouched by the stress event, supported by ledger metrics (capacity usage: 0.08) noted in the ledger status box.
all.why: Provides a rigorous, structural depiction of contagion containment that clearly demonstrates how isolation halts cascading liquidations before they cross into shared system liquidity.
